messages:
maria (sec): Quick planning thread for the upcoming pentest window next Mon 09:00-13:00 PT. Need clear RBAC windows, KMS access pattern, audit capture, and retest SLA. Who owns?
ajay: I'll own access. Summary: ephemeral assessor roles, presigned readroom for artifacts, KMS decrypt via proxy only, CloudTrail data events to audit acct, and a remediation tracker mapping.
kevin (infra): KMS: create a key with key policy granting decrypt to kms-proxy role only. Assessors never get direct key principals. Use sts assume-role (OIDC/SAML) with 1h sessions.
donna (sre): Oncall coverage confirmed. We'll have a rollback corridor and pause criteria if any test looks like active exploitation.
sec-bot: [auto] intake received: SOW, assessor list, evidence bucket provisioned (s3://pt-2026-evidence). Readroom creds: pending.
lia (compliance): Add object tags for classification and retention: classification=restricted, retention=90d unless ticket flagged. Presigned PUTs must enforce tags.
ajay: Role policy sketch will be in PEN-3001: allow s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket on evidence bucket; explicitly Deny s3:PutObject and iam:*, ec2:Modify*. Session must include assessor-id tag.
kevin (infra): Smoke commands to validate: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-assessor --role-session-name smoke --duration-seconds 3600` then `aws s3 cp s3://pt-2026-evidence/readme.txt -` using temp creds. I'll run a dry-run and post logs.
donna (sre): Retest policy: critical -> retest within 72h; high -> next available mid-week slot; medium/low -> standard queue. Need owners to claim on PEN-3001 tracker.
ajay: I'll add evidence-schema: /assessor-uploads/{assessor-id}/{ticket-id}/{artifact}. Also pre-seed presigned GETs for readroom.
maria (sec): Ensure CloudTrail data events are enabled for the bucket and forwarded to the audit account. Tag AssumeRole events with assessor-id so we can map uploads to sessions.
kevin (infra): We can require TagSession in trust policy and validate in CloudTrail. Example condition snippet will be in the runbook.
sec-bot: [auto] dry-run scheduled: 1782350000 (tomorrow 14:00 PT). Reminder will ping 30m prior.
ajay: I'll run the dry-run and paste the outputs here; will also update Terraform snippet in PEN-3001.
lia (compliance): Confirmed retention & tagging requirements.
donna (sre): ack (oncall + rollback corridor).
maria (sec): Please one-line ack if you can attend the dry-run and own your item.
ajay: ack.
kevin (infra): ack.
lia (compliance): ack.
donna (sre): ack.
maria (sec): Thanks, I'll close intake after we collect smoke logs and update the runbook.
